entries.artha_hindi: kisI ko jAnanA, jAganA, bAwa johanA

examples: 'aprabudDA paSoH SaktiH prabudDA kOlikasya ca. nareSvare jagatsarvaM nimIlati nimIlati… tatpraboDe prabuDyate (hita॰4.135).. (1) prabADate pratanotItyarTaH. praSabdo'rTaviparyAsakft. na mftyusenAmAyAntI jAtu kaScit prabADate (=vArayati).

'kaTaM na dEvaM Sakyeta pOruzeRa prabADitum' (BA॰saBA॰46.20). prabADitum=pIqayitum, virodDum, nihantum. 'dinakaraBAH prabADamAnaM varzatram' (rA॰2.107.18). dinakaraBA iti dvitIyAbahuvacane rUpam. prabADamAnam=nivArayat.

F.N.

(1.ityAdayaH paYca paNktayaH sTAnaBrazwA bADfDAtuprasaNge karmARItyato'nantarampAWyAH.)
'na sambubuDire cEnaM devAstaM BuvaneSvaram' (BA॰droRa॰202.94). na sambubuDire=na pratyaBijajYuH=na paricikyuH.
'tasya vftrArditasyATa moha AsIcCatakratoH. raTantareRa taM tatra vasizWaH samaboDayat' (BA॰SAM॰281.21). prabudDamakarodityAha.
'ete samboDayAmastvAM DarmaM ca anupAlaya' (liNgapu0 pU0 66.83). samboDayAmaH praboDayAmaH.
'dEvatamantareRa na Sakyo devatApadArTaH samyagavabodDum' (ni0 7.1 ityatra durgavacanam). avabodDuM sAkalyenAvagantum.
'evaM vyutTApite Darme bahuDA vipraboDite. niScayaM nADigacCAmaH saMmUQAH surasattama' (BA0 ASva0 49.13).. vipraboDite=boDite=varRite=nirUpite. viprAvanarTakO, tadarTasya bahuDetyanenEvoktatvAt.
